changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingpayment AS SELECT bp.id, bp.payment_number, bp.wallet_id, bp.patient_id, bp.encounter_id, bp.payment_category, bp.payer_type, bp.payer_id, bp.amount, bp.currency, bp.status, bp.payment_date, bp.receipt_number, bp.external_reference, bp.idempotency_key, bp.notes, bp.created_by, bp.created_date, bp.last_modified_by, bp.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_payment bp;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingpayment TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingpayment FROM report_user;
